text: The Multilin Capacitor Bank Controller includes a Reverse Power Detection function, which defines the minimum pickup required to detect reverse power conditions.
heading: Protection

text: In situations where the capacitor bank has been tripped due to a neutral current unbalance situation, the Multilin Capacitor Bank Controller will execute a reclose action to validate the state of the fault, ensuring the fault was not transient in nature. This automatic reclose action ensures maximizes system reliability.
heading: Protection

text: The Multilin Capacitor Bank Controller offers powerful I/O and programmable FlexLogic™ options for advanced automation control, reducing the need for additional programmable controllers or discrete control relays. The Multilin Capacitor Bank Controller has three identical set point groups. The activation of the group can be done either from the HMI or via a Digital Input.
